name: Grade 6 T2: Robotics Safety and mBot Parts
description: Robotics routines, safe handling, robot parts, sensors, motors, boards, LEDs, buzzers, and power.

words.definition: A machine that can follow instructions to complete tasks.
words.example: The mBot is a robot that can move and respond to sensors.

words.definition: A small educational robot used to learn programming, movement, sensors, and outputs.
words.example: The group programmed the mBot to move forward.

words.definition: A set of instructions that tells a computer or robot what to do.
words.example: The program made the robot stop at the tape line.

words.definition: A step or command that tells a robot what action to perform.
words.example: Each instruction must be clear and in the correct order.

words.definition: Rules and habits that protect people and materials from harm.
words.example: Robotics safety includes carrying the mBot carefully.

words.definition: A repeated classroom process for starting, using, and putting away materials.
words.example: The class followed the charging routine after using the robots.

words.definition: The pieces that make up a robot or device.
words.example: The students labeled the mBot parts on a diagram.

words.definition: A labeled drawing that shows the parts of something.
words.example: The diagram showed the wheels, motors, board, sensors, LEDs, and buzzer.

words.definition: A round part that turns and helps a robot move.
words.example: The mBot uses wheels to roll across the floor.

words.definition: A part that creates movement by turning or spinning.
words.example: The motor turns the wheel when the robot moves forward.

words.definition: The main board or part that runs a robot's program.
words.example: The controller sends instructions to the motors and outputs.

words.definition: An electronic part that connects and controls other robot parts.
words.example: The board connected the sensors, lights, and motors.

words.definition: A part that detects something from the environment.
words.example: The sensor helped the robot notice an object.

words.definition: A small light that can be controlled by a program.
words.example: The LED turned blue when the robot started.

words.definition: A part that makes a sound when programmed.
words.example: The buzzer played a tone when the robot finished.

words.definition: Energy that allows a robot or device to work.
words.example: The mBot needed power from the battery before it could move.

words.definition: A part that stores energy for a robot or device.
words.example: The students checked that the battery was charged.

words.definition: A cable or connection used to send data or power between devices.
words.example: The USB cable connected the mBot to the computer.

words.definition: A place where a cable or part connects to a device.
words.example: The sensor cable plugged into the correct port.

words.definition: A wire used to connect parts or devices.
words.example: The cable carried power or information between parts.

words.definition: The steps needed to prepare a robot or device before using it.
words.example: The setup included checking power, cables, and the test area.

words.definition: A set of materials or parts used for a project.
words.example: Each team checked that the mBot kit was complete.
